question.prompt: A taxi charges 10 yuan for a trip of up to 3 km and 2 yuan per km beyond that. What function gives the fare \(y\) for a trip of \(x\) km (\(x>3\))? (Simplify to the form \(y=kx+b\).)

solutions.explanation: The distance beyond 3 km is \((x-3)\) km, so the fare is \(y=10+2(x-3)=2x+4\).
solutions.title: Add the base fare and excess-distance charge
